message: No detected input validation: The code only strips and uppercases the ticker string and fills NaN values; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the acquired data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched directly from Yahoo Finance via pandas_datareader with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or any other integrity/authenticity check on the remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool is used anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only fills NaN values via ffill/bfill; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly check, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds LSTM models dynamically via Keras Sequential API and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model files, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is present or needed—but equally, no such control exists anywhere in the shown code.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no class balance check, expected-label-set verification, or anomalous-sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied; standard Keras/TensorFlow optimizers are used without noise mechanisms.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train-test split is performed, there is no hashing, signing, or isolation mechanism to prevent leakage or tampering of the evaluation data, and only a single metric (MSE via sklearn) appears to be used without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The ticker input is only stripped and uppercased (line ~47 in predictor.py), with no shape, range, or schema validation before being passed to data preparation and the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference path applies inverse_transform on predictions and plots them directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an LSTM-based time-series model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
